name: agent-design-taste
title_zh: 先拆产品再挑风格的 UI 设计监理
tagline_zh: 受够了千篇一律的「现代 AI 风」？它逼你先想清楚给谁看、要什么，再挑一种风格，从真实 token 搭到渲染审计。
tagline_en: Tired of generic 'modern AI' look? It forces product-audience analysis, deliberate style choice, real tokens, and.
desc_en: Use when generating, redesigning or reviewing any UI — landing page, dashboard, app screen, component, or design system. Teaches the agent to analyze product and audience first, choose one design style deliberately, build from real tokens, render it, and audit it — instead of producing generic "modern premium AI SaaS" output.
why_zh: 不是模板堆砌，而是先分析产品与受众，再刻意选择风格，用真实设计系统构建并审计。
why_en: Not template-driven: it analyzes product and audience, picks one style deliberately, builds from real tokens, and audits—killing.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 UI 生成、重设计与审查流程，不处理交互原型或动效；需要你提供明确的产品背景或受众描述，否则它可能反复追问。
limit_en: Only covers UI generation/redesign/review, not prototyping or motion. Needs explicit product/audience context, else it may keep asking.
title_en: UI design auditor that analyzes first, then styles
